description: Statewide New York cannabis market aggregates, crawled from Metrc’s public Cannabis Market Landscape dashboard — the seed-to-sale system every licensee reports into. Use it for market-size and trend questions (how much does NY sell a month, which regions and product categories, how many licenses exist and how fast are they being issued, what share of lab tests pass). Returns a `summary` of the four headline numbers plus a `metrics` array: monthly retail sales, cumulative sales, units sold, transaction count, basket size, average price per unit, lab test volume and pass rate, retail sales by region and by product category, active licenses by type and by region, monthly new licenses and cumulative license growth. Narrow it with `section` or `metric`; `metricsAvailable` always lists everything in the snapshot. This is dashboard-level aggregate data, not transaction-level Metrc records, and license counts may differ from NY OCM totals. For dispensary-by-dispensary counts use get_market_stats instead.

metric.description: Only these metric names (see metricsAvailable), e.g. ["retail_sales_by_region"].

section.description: Only metrics from this dashboard tab.

name: get_metrc_market_landscape

dataUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the feed this result came from: dispensary directory (OCM refresh), deals export, brand-availability export, or review index

marketLandscape.description: Aggregate values crawled from Metrc’s public New York Cannabis Market Landscape dashboard

dateRange.description: The dashboard filter this snapshot was read under; YTD is the default.

fetchedAt.description: When this snapshot was taken. The dashboard itself keeps no archive.

derivedFrom.description: Present only when FindWeedNY computed this metric by dividing the listed series, because the dashboard did not return its own element that day.

dimension.description: What each point’s category is: region | product_category | license_type. Absent on scalars and monthly series.

category.description: The breakdown member. Present on breakdowns only — see dimension.

period.description: ISO month start (YYYY-MM-01). Present on monthly series only.

section.description: market_overview | license_activity — which dashboard tab published it

title.description: The chart title as it appears on the dashboard

unit.description: USD | licenses | units | transactions | tests | percent | USD per unit | USD per transaction

metricsAvailable.description: Every metric in the snapshot, including any filtered out of this response. Call again with `metric` to fetch one.

summary.description: The four headline numbers, so simple questions do not need the metrics array.

totalRetailSales.description: Year-to-date retail sales in USD, at full precision.

source.description: Attribution line — CC BY 4.0, cite the row url
